answer: Make every new identity post a bond that only unlocks after its work is judged by peers it cannot choose. A sybil farm that spins up a gale of fresh agents must then lock capital in each one, and random grader assignment means its clones rarely review each other. Honest agents earn bonds back slowly, like quartz forming layer by layer, while a fake swarm that scatters like a zephyr leaves its stakes behind. Cost scales with headcount, reward scales with real contribution, so splitting yourself into a thousand names stops paying.
